title: PAR-20/7G.3 EVALUATION_GRAPH owner closure, NOD identity, and record cardinality
scope: Close the local EVALUATION_GRAPH owner-reference gap, NOD owner-zero identity, and typed record cardinality on the generated output route.

Require a resolvable owner for ordinary generated EVALUATION_GRAPH records and exactly one re-imported record in both ASCII and Binary DXF while preserving existing unique-handle, expression-target, and NOD-first checks.
Reuse the existing focused adapter test and CTests without changing fixture inventory or test registration.

sourceChange.change: evaluationGraphCaptureLimitsFailClosed now runs in both ASCII and Binary DXF and requires the re-imported NOD to have owner handle zero and exactly one typed EVALUATION_GRAPH record, in addition to NOD-first ordering, unique OBJECTS handles, exact graph-to-NOD owner identity, one resolvable LINE expression target, and an atomic refusal when the graph owner is changed to an unresolved handle. dx_iface::prepareExtensionObjectGraph now validates ordinary EvaluationGraph owner references against accepted empty/default roots, the NOD, registered BLOCK_RECORD identities, and owners already traversed through supported object routes; the separately validated ACDS history lane is not conflated with this ordinary graph route.
sourceChange.reason: Autodesk defines the common object 330 field as an optional owner-dictionary pointer and an owner-object pointer. A test-first generated DXF mutation showed that strict export previously accepted a dangling EvaluationGraph owner and replaced the destination. The same closure check also preserves the selected root's owner-zero identity and exact typed record count without guessing a root dictionary key.

scopeDecision.evidence: An initial generated-output probe found no ACAD_EVALUATION_GRAPH entry in the NOD. The current route emits the graph with its owner set to the NOD; no authoritative source or current plan requirement found in this slice establishes a required NOD key for this object.
scopeDecision.policy: Do not infer that a root dictionary key is required or alter output from this observation alone. Keep root-entry semantics open for a source-backed follow-up.
